name: uot-per-flow-transport
title: UoT v2 per-flow UDP transport for SOCKS5 targets
description: Opt-in UDP-over-TCP v2 connect mode for SOCKS5 UDP targets: one pipelined TCP connection per flow, removing the ASSOCIATE round-trip dependency before the first datagram and halving per-flow descriptors, measured against the native per-flow path.
